name: Endgame + failure states
summary: Broke, one interest tick from ship seizure, Red Zone licensed with 10 turns done, and two Invaded worlds on the board.
unlocks: Core Rules p.76 — upkeep FAILURE: crew lockout ('for each credit you are short, one crew member will refuse to do any jobs'), sell-for-upkeep, dismiss crew
Core Rules p.75 — ship debt seizure (ShiplessSystem fires at >= 75) and shipless play
Core Rules p.126 — Galactic War: the 2D6 table only rolls when Invaded planets are tracked; on device it has only ever declined to roll
Core Rules Appendix III pp.148-151 — Red Zone and Black Zone jobs (licence + 10 completed Red Zone turns)
Compendium p.147 — the Scrapper and what Salvage may be spent on
note: credits 0 against a 6-crew upkeep of 1 credit (p.76) forces the failure branch on the very next World Phase. Ship debt 74 with the standard +2/turn interest crosses the >= 75 seizure threshold next rollover, so both failure paths arrive together rather than needing separate runs.
